newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR THURS.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR THURS.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Thursday it had set a tender for a seven-day securities reverse repurchase for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering to drain an unspecified volume of market liquidity.
The NBS said in a statement that the American-style tender would have no fixed minimum rate.
According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 96.53 percent as of Wednesday, after 95.65 percent the previous day.
In Wednesday's reverse repo tender of a similar maturity, the NBS said it had rejected all bids totalling 450 million crowns due to higher than acceptable bid rates.
